Subject: SI-CP-0007 cold plate qualification — request for information (SUP-07)

Dear Oscorp team,

Thank you for your qualification packet for the NPI liquid-cooling cold plate, part SI-CP-0007, revision A, drawing SI-DWG-CP-0007. To complete our review, please send the following:

1. 2.pfmea — Your current Process FMEA for part SI-CP-0007. Your quality manual (§9.1) says you review manufacturing failure modes for this part; please provide the PFMEA document itself, with its revision and date.
2. 4.cleanliness — An internal cleanliness test report for SI-CP-0007. Your reliability report (§1.2) says the internal passages meet the particle limits; please provide the measured particle counts per part for each complete internal wetted circuit, against Stark's limits of ≤ 100 particles at least 100 µm and 0 particles at least 500 µm.

Please reply with these documents at your earliest convenience.

Kind regards,

Stark Industries Supplier Quality — Pepper Potts

audit_plan.question: capability_study.md §1.1 gives Port bore Cpk 1.217917313999748 (n=50) and Base thickness Cpk 1.26181964340477. On site, pull the raw Port bore and Base thickness measurement data and gauge records, confirm the Cpk calculation, and review what actions are planned to reduce variation and centre the process.

reliability_report.md §1.2 claims the internal passages meet the particle limits but gives no data. On site, watch or review an internal cleanliness extraction on a complete wetted circuit and check the particle counts against Stark's limits (≤ 100 particles ≥ 100 µm, 0 particles ≥ 500 µm).

capacity.md §1.2 quotes a 15-week lead time against Stark's 12-week need-by. On site, go through the lead-time build-up (material, sub-tier, machining, test) and find which steps drive the 3 extra weeks, and whether the ramp in capacity.md §1.3 (400 parts/week added from 2026-11-01) changes that.
